title: The pre-release or monitor judge fails
description: The pre-release judge or a monitor times out or errors; audio that needs the judge is not released, and safety and error audio stay usable.
callerVisible: The caller hears an approved template instead of generated text, or is connected to a person.
backendEvidence: Release refused for judge-dependent audio; approved template used
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:JUDGE_FAILURE] owned by WP-35 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: the pre-release or monitor judge times out or errors

postconditions: Judge-dependent audio is never released without a verdict
Safety and error audio do not depend on the judge
The failure is visible to monitors
